title: Pohl and colleagues, 2013: muonic and electronic proton radii disagree
summary: A 2013 review says the proton radius from muonic hydrogen disagrees with the radius from electronic hydrogen and from electron-proton scattering. It does not print the 2022 CODATA value.
body: The abstract of Pohl, Gilman, Miller, and Pachucki says the extraction of the proton radius by Pohl and colleagues from the measured 2P–2S energy difference in muonic hydrogen disagrees significantly with the radius extracted from electronic hydrogen or from elastic electron-proton scattering. They call that disagreement the proton radius puzzle. The abstract identifies the disagreement and discusses possible solutions. It does not print a radius in femtometres on the abstract page that was opened. The 2022 CODATA recommended radius is a later row, on world.physics.proton-radius. This 2013 paper does not state that later recommendation, and this card does not treat the 2022 row as a resolution the 2013 authors announced.
